core_obligations: Identify the freeness locus using the pointwise criterion and show it is constructible.
Upgrade constructibility to openness using flatness and finite presentation, and verify commutation with arbitrary base change.

proof_roadmap.step: Apply the pointwise freeness criterion to describe the locus.
Compare the locus with its base change.

difficulty_reason: For a locally finitely presented morphism of algebraic spaces and a finitely presented module flat over the target, the lemma shows that the set of points where the module is free in an etale neighbourhood is open and that its formation commutes with arbitrary base change. The proof applies the pointwise freeness criterion to identify the locus with a constructible set, then uses flatness and finite presentation to upgrade constructibility to openness, and finally compares the locus with the corresponding locus after base change. The comparison with base change is the load-bearing part. Retained author proof at lines 6001-6040.
